working_agreement: Requested 2026-11-12: set up and start implementing. Design decisions were agreed on 2026-11-12. Implement the planned slices in order and fix in-scope review findings. Standing approval from 2026-11-12 for the remaining slices: commit each slice, push its branch, and open its pull request without asking again. Ask before merging or publishing.

criteria.a1: No tool implementation is reachable with schema-invalid arguments
criteria.a2: In ask mode write, edit, bash, and MCP calls prompt before executing; read, grep, find, and ls inside the workspace do not
criteria.a3: A denial returns to the model as a tool result and the turn continues
criteria.a4: A persisted allow rule suppresses the prompt in a new session; a deny rule cannot be overridden by an allow rule, a session grant, or a preset
criteria.a5: A session approval of a tool or request type suppresses further prompts until the session ends, is restored on resume, and does not carry into a new session
criteria.a6: A fresh install with no configuration starts in ask
criteria.a7: Every preset is covered by a test stating which calls it allows, asks about, and denies
criteria.a8: Non-interactive mode never blocks on a prompt
criteria.a9: Each decision appears in the trace with rule and actor
criteria.a10: policy imports nothing from the application and passes a guarded-import test
criteria.a11: An approval request survives a JSON round trip and is answered from outside the process that raised it
criteria.a12: Two policy instances with different owner scopes in one process do not see each other's rules

a1.check: src/tools/__tests__/argumentValidation.test.ts: built-in sweep (no built-in runs with schema-invalid arguments), registry cases, dialects, re-check at dispatch; src/mcp/__tests__/boundary.test.ts and tool.test.ts: server not called, strict 2020-12, schema check kept without an MCP check; src/agent-core/__tests__/runtime.test.ts: validation before policy, throwing check. npm test passed (117 suites, 1,787 tests); build, format check, fallow audit passed. CI passed on the preceding push.
